title: Moula Abbas a.s
body:
ROHUL AMI NE ROKE KAHA WAWAILA WAWAILA
Roohul Amee Ne R0ke Kaha Wawaila Wawaila
Hgaye Zakhmi Shere Khuda Wawaila Wawaila
1 Ghar Me Khuda Ke Ahle Yaqeen
Khatl Hua Kaabe Ka Makeen
Haaye Musalla Khoon Se Bhara
Wawaila Wawaila
2 Zakhmi Hue Sajde Me Ali
Khabr Mein Tadpi Roohe Nabi
Gham Se Phata Khalbe Zahra
Wawaila Wawaila
3 Khatl Hue Haaye Haider
Dono Jaha Mei Hai Mahshar
Kaap Rahe Hai Arz-O- Sama
Wawaila Wawaila
4 Gham Ki Khabar Jaise Hi Sune
Rote Hue Hasnain Chale
Hashr Hua Masjid Mein Bapa
Wawaila Wawaila
5 Masjid Mein Jab Aaye Hasan
Baba Se Farmaaye Hasan
Haaye Ye Kisne Zulm Kiya
Wawaila Wawaila
6 Sjdaye Haq Mein The Maula
Sar Pe Layi Ne Waar Kiya
Deen Ke Sutoon Ko Dhaya Gaya
Wawaila Wawaila
7 Qatl Hue Sultaane Umam
Dono Jaha Mein Hain Matam
Goonji Do Aalam Me Ye Sada
Wawaila Wawaila
8 Aabed-O-Mazhar Ka Nawha
Kahte Hain Sunkar Ahle Aza
Bangaya Ramzan Maahe Azaa
Wawaila Wawaila
